model: ROLEX GMT-Master II 126711CHNR (40 mm steel and Everose gold Rolesor, black dial, brown and black Cerachrom 24 h 'Root Beer' bezel with Everose coin edge, date with Cyclops lens, Everose GMT hand, Oyster bracelet with Everose centre links)
note: Follower of the GMT-Master II 40 template (126710BLNR) via the Oyster follower 126710BLRO: same step / prep / kit preset (read-only), per-photo measure / spec / job only. Everose parts (rim, coin edge, crown, centre links, hands) are photo pixels of the projected steel map: no separate material. Front relief: flat back at z = 0, dial faces +z. mm, origin = hand pivot. 40 mm, 60-flute coin edge, FOUR hands (Everose GMT shaft + triangle head as one traced polygon), three-column Oyster bracelet (outer / centre / outer). Native 1920 x 2857 photo, 23.14 px/mm, no texture scaling.

case.note: outline = photo silhouette (lug top y 903.5 = 22.49 mm, lug bottom y 1992.5 = 24.57 mm, crown guards to x 1472 = 22.13 mm); the slab slopes toward the bracelet

bezel.note: 24 h ceramic insert (bezel_in 15.83 .. insert_out 18.84 mm; blue / black split and numerals are texture), flat polished rim to rim_out 19.14, coin edge (60 flutes) from there to the tips at 20.0 mm sloping down to z_coin_out

hands.note: hands = traced photo outlines (trace.hands[name].outline_mm) as flat polygons, the Everose GMT hand (shaft + triangle head) between hour and minute hand; lume, Mercedes lines, Everose colour and facets stay in the projected photo

crown.note: fluted Rolex crown (guards are in the case slab): flutes x 1428..1488, cap to 1514, axis 0.6 mm below the pivot, 16 coarse flutes

strap.note: strap.bracelet.columns lists the column kinds left to right; bounds_x_mm holds one boundary less; pieces_mm has top / bottom [y0, y1] chains per kind

bracelet.note: Oyster bracelet, three columns (outer brushed steel links, wide polished Everose centre link). Joint rows identical to 126710BLRO (same camera and bracelet): verified on this photo by column-profile cross-correlation against the 126710BLRO photo (best shift 0 px at the centre, left and right outer columns, top and bottom), centre dark bands read directly (top 728..742 and 879..884; bottom 2215..2228, 2374..2407), column lines by the R-B gradient maxima (x 860 / 1059 top, 859.5 / 1059.5 bottom). Rows px (23.14 px/mm, pivot (960, 1424)): outer top step 759.5, end 685; outer bottom 2181 / 2367 / 2483, end 2514; centre top 880 / 735.5, bottom 2004 / 2222 / 2392 / 2505. The dark bands and rolled strips are reflections and stay texture. Outer link edges come from the alpha silhouette.

crystal.note: alpha-blended, not transmission: web viewers blur the dial behind transmission glass

date.note: Cyclops lens: photographed outline (measure.date.lens_px) as a wall + two bevel rings + flat top above the crystal; photo projection; heights are scaled by pose.depth_scale like every part
